lido-earn.event: Fees switched on: 10% performance, 1% annual; switched off 21 Jul
Carry account borrows 5M USDT and buys earnUSD in one tx
lido-earn.effect_on_deposits_or_yield: adds a dollar-carry leg inside the nested strategy

avant.event: avETH, savETH and AvantMintingV2 deployed by EOA 0xa5ab0683; savETH cooldown 7 days
Ownership of avETH, savETH and minting moved to EOA 0xd4d23209 (via 0xd47777cf)
avant.effect_on_deposits_or_yield: single key controls mint, cooldown and pools

avant.event: savETH cooldown cut from 7 days to 1 day
First daily reward pushed to savETH
avant.effect_on_deposits_or_yield: senior yield starts (1.91 avETH in Sep)

avant.event: Per-block mint and redeem caps raised 250 to 5,000 avETH
First savETH supplied to Morpho savETH/WETH markets (loops)
avant.effect_on_deposits_or_yield: by T 17.63% of savETH sits in Morpho; one EOA owns 37.8% look-through

avant.event: Admin starts setting cooldown to 60 s for short windows (30 times to 2026-09-27; longest 30 Jul-6 Aug)
avant.effect_on_deposits_or_yield: some exits skip the 24h cooldown; no on-chain notice

avant.event: Admin EOA grants itself COLLATERAL_MANAGER_ROLE on AvantMintingV2
avant.effect_on_deposits_or_yield: admin can move minting collateral to custody

avant.event: Issuer discloses $72.65M assets, $39.47M liabilities, $33.18M net NAV, $32.53M in savUSD
avant.effect_on_deposits_or_yield: ETH product depends on Avant dollar credit

liquity.event: PlasmaVault, AccessManager, FeeManager, WithdrawManager deployed; deposits whitelist-only
First deposit (whitelisted EIP-7702 EOA 0x81fa729b, also owner/atomist)
First Ebisu trove opened (rETH branch); closed 9 Mar, then wstETH branch
liquity.effect_on_deposits_or_yield: live route is Ebisu ebUSD, not Liquity BOLD

liquity.event: Deposits opened to the public; 0.2% deposit, withdraw and request fees set
Vault closed by guardian for 15 minutes, then reopened
liquity.effect_on_deposits_or_yield: all user functions blocked during the window

liquity.event: Current Ebisu wstETH trove opened; owner, guardian and atomist moved to Safe 2-of-3 (6 to 11 Jun)
liquity.effect_on_deposits_or_yield: control moved from one EOA to a 2-of-3 Safe

liquity.event: New strategist EOA 0xad34f0fe gets ALPHA; previous EOA removed next day
Rocksolid rETH execution account enters (12.1% at T); Rocksolid enters Closing on 29 Sep
liquity.effect_on_deposits_or_yield: a closing product holds 728 ETH of this vault
